reviews.summary: Kitemana rode the 8m Bandit 17 TEC in strong wind: medium-to-high bar pressure, very direct and responsive, big depower from the pulley and strong upwind ability. Lift and hangtime are good for a 3-strut but below dedicated big air kites, loops catch quickly, and it resisted frontstalling. A true all-rounder rather than a wave or foil specialist.

structured_review.summary: A direct, responsive 3-strut all-rounder with medium-to-high bar pressure, big depower from its pulley and unusually strong upwind ability. Lift and hangtime are good for a 3-strut but well below dedicated big air kites, and it is a generalist rather than a wave or foil specialist.
pros: Big depower range thanks to the pulley
Loops catch quickly and it resisted frontstalling
Versatile across freeride, freestyle and waves
cons: Less lift and hangtime than dedicated big air kites
Not as good in waves or on a foil as F-One's specialist kites
structured_review.best_for: Riders who want one responsive freeride kite for jumping, loops and mixed conditions.
structured_review.not_for: Big air specialists or dedicated wave and foil riders.
structured_review.rec_blurb: A direct, upwind-hungry all-rounder that does a bit of everything well.
